description: Follow-on to fz-21x.16. Once LoweredBody carries its definition and use tables, ownership derivation (construct_call_ownership, construct_tuple_ownership, list rewrite permission in src/compiler2/jobs/body.rs construct_entry_captures) can leave lowering and become its own fact: body in, ownership modes out, reusable when a body is re-lowered unchanged (north-star priority 6, body-incremental native compilation). Not needed for correctness; measure with the lowering span's steps-visited measurement and the evaluation ratchets.
title: Lift tuple and call ownership out of lowering into a job over the published body
